# gcore_waap_domain_policy (Data Source)

WAAP security policies are the built-in protection rules of a domain. Each policy can be turned on or off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_waap_domain_policy" "example_waap_domain_policy" {
  domain_id = 1
  policy_id = "S1234"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The domain ID
- `policy_id` (String) The ID of the policy to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy to retrieve
- `mode` (Boolean) Indicates if the security rule is active
